prerequisite.carrier_promotion_rule: ordinary non-force fast-forward through independently accepted path10 then accepted path11 validation ancestry before verifier implementation

acceptance_sequence.name: accepted_path11_ancestry
require: accepted_path10_head and accepted_path11_head are filled only from independent acceptance evidence
verifier carrier is identical to accepted_path11_head before path12 implementation
validation-chain history is used only to obtain the verifier blob and is never promoted as final R2 history

acceptance_sequence.name: path_delta
require: accepted_path11_head -> path12 candidate changes exactly one path
the path is target_path
status is modified
mode remains 100644 and type remains blob

acceptance_sequence.name: historical_contract_preservation
require: _require_single_fast_forward_commit historical semantics remain unchanged
C2A_POST_F0L_ALLOWLIST remains the historical R1 allowlist
C2A_NEW_PATHS remains exactly 9
G9->R1 historical shape remains exactly 17 paths = 9 added + 8 modified

acceptance_sequence.name: dedicated_r2_topology
require: dedicated _require_c2a_r2_topology or semantic equivalent exists
exact G9 base is enforced
exactly two commits above G9 are enforced
ordered commit 1 is exact immutable R1 with exact tree and sole G9 parent
ordered commit 2 is final R2 with sole exact R1 parent
merge ancestry, R1-only state, third commit, wrong parent/tree or predecessor drift fail closed

acceptance_sequence.name: exact_path_and_preimage_contract
require: R1->R2 exact correction set is exactly 12 paths and every status is M
all 12 R1 preimage blobs and 100644 blob modes/types are exact
every final R2 entry remains 100644 blob and differs from its R1 preimage
G9->R2 aggregate is exactly 19 paths = 9 new + 10 existing
the two additional existing aggregate paths are audited_authoring.mjs and test_read_only_static_contracts.py

acceptance_sequence.name: freeze_and_registry_preservation
require: audited_authoring.mjs receives only the exact R2-only frozen-path exemption
no global weakening of C2A_FROZEN_PATHS occurs
models, migrations, schemas, pyproject.toml, domain lifecycle/persistence authority, G9 evidence semantics and cdp_client.mjs remain frozen
portable registry remains exactly 13 and Chromium registry exactly 2

acceptance_sequence.name: negative_self_check_matrix
require: self-check rejects R1-only topology
self-check rejects third commit, wrong R1 identity/tree/parent, wrong R2 parent and merge parent count
self-check rejects missing/extra correction path and any non-M status
self-check rejects aggregate 18/20, wrong 9-new/10-existing split, preimage or mode drift, and exemption leakage

acceptance_sequence.name: preserved_verification_surfaces
require: same-run evidence checks remain enforced
migration/no-drift checks remain enforced
wheel content and isolated-install checks remain enforced
workflow contract checks remain enforced
synthetic-tree equivalence checks remain enforced

acceptance_sequence.name: executable_gate
require: verifier syntax/self-check passes
negative self-check matrix passes without weakening
a synthetic final tree built from immutable R1 plus exactly the 12 accepted replacement blobs is accepted only under the dedicated R2 topology
the same verifier rejects at least one representative wrong-parent, third-commit, path-drift, aggregate-drift and preimage-drift synthetic case

acceptance_sequence.name: capture_and_final_assembly_authorization
require: record exact path12 candidate HEAD, TREE, sole parent and verifier blob
record exact one-path changed inventory and executable evidence
re-read PR #94 and prove OPEN/DRAFT/UNMERGED at immutable R1
only after steps 1-9 PASS count path12 prepared and advance formal count from 11/12 to 12/12
final R2 must then be assembled as one ordinary child of immutable R1 using the 12 accepted replacement blobs; never promote the multi-commit validation chain itself
